description: DR-278 class O (kernel plan v2 of DR-168, section 7): public store.search of int8 stores with and without the int8 prefilter, base against candidate, on the 859,346 WikiText-103 training paragraphs (wikitext-train, int8 rows, 2 workers, k 10). The queries are 256 fixed STS-B test texts outside the store (PCG64 seed 0, digest in every record), encoded outside the timer; every call searches the next block of queries and a group starts at the first block, so both builds run the same calls and their outputs must be bit-identical. Cells O1 to O3 carry the decision gate; the practical limit of a 10 percent saving (and a confirmation of at least half of it) is fixed before the measurement and read from the report by hand, because the tool applies only the noise rule. N1 and N2 assess non-regression explicitly from the paired factor (median at least 0.98, confirmation not below it), not from the descriptive_only tool label. R1 to R5 are the preliminary regression screen (5 percent limit) for the paths that must stay unchanged; run them with --local-phase regression-screen only. Nothing is enabled unless O1 to O3 reach the limit and N1 and N2 pass; otherwise the data go to the maintainer and no range is cut afterwards. Local development indication on one machine, no publication. Measure only in a window that fse-main grants.
